hypothesis: Every one of the 196 rules is decided by a simple certificate: length decrease, lexicographic monotonicity (length-preserving), a strictly decreasing linear interpretation over N, a decreasing factor count, or a self-embedding derivation w ->+ x w y.
methodology: Apply the certificate searches in order; re-check every self-embedding certificate step by step with an independent checker.
